Overview

Roeselare is a city in West Flanders with a population of 63,000. A vibrant West Flemish city known for its food industry, cycling culture, and the annual Rodenbach bicycle race. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
